bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the review-processing workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization steps on public product reviews and inspected provided query terms and example matches with guidance.

Under supervision, joined review document identifiers to product metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
Within a supervised course project, wrote Python functions for parsing provided research abstract records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization steps on public research abstracts and inspected provided query terms and example matches with guidance.

Under supervision, joined abstract document identifiers to bibliographic metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
Ran a supplied Python notebook to load provided research abstract records and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.
Executed supplied notebook procedures using NLTK to tokenize public research abstracts, then inspected provided query terms and example matches with guidance.

Under supervision, executed supplied pandas and Matplotlib notebook procedures to join abstract identifiers to metadata and visualize group comparisons; checked unmatched records and documented missing-data handling.
